title: Simulation Task
description: Develop a multi-agent simulation system that models the spread of mask-wearing behavior through social networks.
simulation_focus: Predict agents' mask-wearing behavior over day 30 - day 39 (last ten days) based on their attributes, social connections, and past behavior
Model information propagation and behavioral changes triggered by social influence and government intervention starting on Day 10

data_files.agent_attributes.csv: Contains demographic and behavioral attributes of each agent, including age, occupation, risk perception, and social connection counts
data_files.social_network.json: Contains structured data representing a social network. Each entry corresponds to a user (identified by a unique integer ID), and the values describe the different types of relationships that user has with others. Data Structure: The top-level structure is a dictionary ({} in JSON). Keys: Each key is a unique user ID (as an integer, e.g., 0, 1, 2, etc.). Values: Each value is another dictionary with the following fields: "family": a list of user IDs representing family connections. "work_school": a list of user IDs representing colleagues or schoolmates. "community": a list of user IDs representing community-level acquaintances. "all": a merged list of all user IDs connected to the user across the three categories above.
data_files.train_data.csv: Time series data for the first 30 days, used for training the model

RMSE.description: Root Mean Square Error measuring overall predictive accuracy of mask adoption rates
RMSE.interpretation: Directly interpretable as percentage deviations due to the 0-1 range

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People influence each other's mask adoption via social network ties and in-person contacts.

interactions.name: policy_influence
interactions.description: Policy announcements (recommendations/mandates) change perceived benefits/costs and compliance decisions.

interactions.name: media_influence
interactions.description: Media broadcasts affect risk perception and adoption propensity based on reach and message strength.

interactions.name: enforcement
interactions.description: Agents face checks/fines or access restrictions in locations with enforcement, affecting adoption and adherence.

interactions.name: supply_constraint
interactions.description: People attempt to buy masks from retailers; inventory and price affect ability to adopt and adhere.

interactions.name: location_contacts
interactions.description: Co-location at workplaces, schools, and public places creates contact opportunities that drive social influence and enforcement.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Time series of the fraction of people wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption level reached during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: RMSE_to_observed
metrics.description: Root mean squared error between simulated and observed adoption over the calibration period.

metrics.name: MAE_to_observed
metrics.description: Mean absolute error between simulated and observed adoption over the calibration period.

metrics.name: R2_to_observed
metrics.description: Coefficient of determination between simulated and observed adoption over the calibration period.

metrics.name: enforcement_cost
metrics.description: Aggregate cost incurred from enforcement actions (e.g., inspections, fines processing).

metrics.name: inventory_outage_days
metrics.description: Number of days retailers experience zero mask inventory.

validation_criteria.name: calibration_rmse_threshold
validation_criteria.description: Accept model if RMSE_to_observed <= 0.05 absolute adoption fraction over the observed period.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_stability
validation_criteria.description: Stop calibration when no improvement > 1e-4 in objective across 50 iterations or parameter changes fall below 1e-3.

validation_criteria.name: bounds_respect
validation_criteria.description: All parameters remain within specified parameter_bounds; simulated adoption remains in [0,1].

validation_criteria.name: directional_validity
validation_criteria.description: Sensitivity test: increasing mandate effect or enforcement should not decrease adoption, all else equal.
